observations: Upholstered bedframe with a high, tiered headboard featuring gold-colored trim.
Two matching bedside drawers (nightstands) are positioned on either side.
The fabric appears to be a beige or tan velvet-like material.
A mattress and two pillows are visible on the frame, though not explicitly listed in the text.
The item is displayed outdoors on a concrete surface, suggesting a showroom or workshop environment.
Watermark 'GLOBAL DIALA INTERIOR NIG' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on the image.

Close-up photos of the fabric on the headboard and footboard.
